decisions.rationale: Thirty-second held-write evidence supports stalled queue and false backup status, not infinite network behavior. decisions.rationale: Actual PostgreSQL 17.11 confirms compact JSON accepts payloads jsonb::text rejects. 3500 Movies: 1,010,391 compact versus 1,087,390 database bytes; 115 Dogs progress entries: 7,711 versus 8,285. independentReviewCorrections: Explicit account replacement pauses mutations before preservation and read; checks preservation/activation outcomes before replacement.
All account transition and after-await UI updates use owner-generation guards, including successful sign-out completion.
Auth subscription is installed before the initial session read; observed events supersede an older read result.
Background remote placement adoption cancels comparison/review/Undo/import transients to prevent stale indices.
Resolved recovery copies remain accessible; explicit confirmed removal frees bounded capacity, never automatic eviction.
Session-only recovery copies warn before leaving; failed prior-owner departure persistence produces a sticky generic warning across later account transitions without exposing prior-owner contents.

Expanded browser suite found magic-link INITIAL_SESSION/SIGNED_IN activation overlap: awaiting the older transition let boot issue a read before owner activation, then discard it and stay empty/pending. Auth initialization now drains the latest transition until stable and remote reads require activated matching owner. Real vendored-Supabase A→B→A browser case passed in reports/data-safety/2026-10-07T06-08-38-064Z/results.json.

Follow-up browser coverage found an owner switch during the initial remote read could still leave the original tab empty/pending. Startup now loops the complete latest-owner activation/read/flush lifecycle, verifies the same generation and latest activation promise at each asynchronous boundary, and only then marks persistence ready. Both delayed-account-A read and A→B→A sharing regressions passed in reports/data-safety/2026-10-07T06-13-02-844Z/results.json.
